**Claude review** of the whole pull request, at `c989b9b`: all 1 files reviewed.

1 finding(s), 0 to fix; 1 on their lines. Reply in a comment's thread to answer it.

### Summary

The change swaps the `on-demand` gate from `author_association == 'OWNER'` to `comment.user.login == 'csdev19'`. This fixes the case where org-owned repos report the owner as `MEMBER`. It restricts runs to one account, so it does not weaken the trust boundary. I found no correctness or security problems, only a note about the hardcoded login.
